hits.snippet: Press release issued: 25 June 2026 A pioneering fusion technology company with strong links to the University of Bristol has secured £23million in new investment to accelerate the development of breakthrough technology that could transform global cancer diagnosis and treatment. Astral Systems, founded in 2021 by University of Bristol Research Associate Dr Tom Wallace-Smith and chief executive Talmon Firestone, has closed a Series A funding round led by Mercia Ventures, alongside prominent investors including Tees River, Daphni, and Blast Club, with continued support from Speedinvest and Playfair Capital.
